confidence_notes: Paracas-specific meal, coffee and beer estimates are available, but the city has limited aggregated price data. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect tourist-facing restaurant prices and their premium over domestic beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from the supplied comparable-city prices; no live booking prices were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Paracas is a compact destination town, most comparable for lodging to Huacachina. I estimate a modest premium over Huacachina’s $13 dorm, $35 private room, $33 basic room and $48 three-star room because Paracas has coastal and reserve tourism demand, while keeping prices near Lima and Huacachina rather than treating it like a large city.
